name: Salzburg
tagline: Mozart's Baroque city under a fortress
summary: Salzburg is a Baroque gem on the Salzach river, ringed by mountains and crowned by the Hohensalzburg fortress. Mozart was born here, the Sound of Music was filmed here, and its summer festival is one of the world's great music events.
seasonNote: The Salzburg Festival runs from late July to August, when prices rise. December brings Christmas markets. Spring and autumn are quieter.
arrival: Trains from Vienna take 2.5 hours and from Munich 1.5 hours. Salzburg Airport is 20 minutes from the centre.
gettingAround: The old town is walkable; buses cover the rest.
cashTip: Cards work almost everywhere; carry a little cash for mountain huts and small cafés.
foodTip: Salzburger Nockerl soufflé, Mozartkugeln and beer at the Augustiner monastery brewery.
